versions.note: UCI 3-class set (120 imgs). 100% on a 24-image val set is a red flag — too small and too easy to be meaningful.
4-class dataset (4,078 imgs, adds Healthy + Leaf/Neck Blast). Honest 92.9% on 814 held-out images, plus a leaf-validity gate.

revisions.title: Fixed data leakage in the tabular stress classifier
revisions.detail: It scored ~100% because the NDVI-derived label was predicted from NDVI itself. Verified with CV (0.36 without NDVI == baseline; 0.97 with it == leakage) and replaced the black box with a transparent NDVI-vs-benchmark rule.

revisions.title: Added a leaf-validity gate to image scanning
revisions.detail: A classifier confidently labelled a face as a disease. Now an NDVI-style vegetation index runs first and rejects non-foliage (face crop = 0.1% vs leaves ~10%), so no false disease labels.

revisions.title: Distinct disease labels
revisions.detail: Leaf Blast and Neck Blast are now separate classes/treatments instead of a duplicated 'Rice Blast'.

revisions.title: Completed the agent mesh
revisions.detail: Market Price and Pest Risk became real gRPC agents (were gateway stubs). System Status now shows 5/5 agents online and the orchestrator fans out to all five.

revisions.title: Added a test suite
revisions.detail: Pytest coverage for the vegetation gate, treatment mapping, the deterministic stress rule, and the new agents.

revisions.title: Hardened the plant gate against non-plant images
revisions.detail: The single-cue Excess-Green gate passed anything green: an RGB-backlit keyboard scored green_fraction 0.38 (63x the 0.006 floor) and was reported as 'Neck Blast, HIGH, 62%'. Replaced it with four cues calibrated below the 1st percentile of the 814 held-out leaves - foliage hue with a neon-saturation exclusion, exposure, hue dispersion and leaf texture, plus a chroma check for greyscale screenshots. Rejects 0/9 -> 9/9 of a negative set while refusing only 1.0% of real leaves, and the rejection names the cue that failed so the farmer knows what to retake.

revisions.title: Added a prediction confidence gate
revisions.detail: The 4-class softmax has no 'unknown' class, and Neck Blast scores top1=1.000 on every val image, so it absorbed out-of-distribution photos. Predictions now need top-1, margin over the runner-up and normalised entropy to agree before a disease is named: CONFIRMED (>=0.80/0.45/<=0.35), PROVISIONAL (>=0.55/0.20/<=0.70, severity capped one notch and flagged), otherwise the diagnosis is withheld. On the val set this answers 95.5% of images at 93.2% accuracy, up from 91.0% when every image was answered.
